# Conversion Matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs-matrix.ts from the catalog. Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm docs:matrix`. -->

Every conversion the platform offers, generated from the registry (`catalog/`). A
conversion is offered only when an available engine supports it with a status other than
`unsupported` — see [FORMAT-REGISTRY.md](FORMAT-REGISTRY.md) for how routes and statuses
are derived, and [ENGINE-MAPPING.md](ENGINE-MAPPING.md) for the engines behind them.

## Summary

| | Full deployment | Browser-only deployment |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Formats in the catalog | 182 | 182 |
| Formats with offered conversions | 155 | 35 |
| Conversions offered | 1554 | 205 |
| Indexable conversion pages | 1294 | 205 |
| Tools offered | 24 | 16 |
| Conversions that can run in the browser | 205 | 205 |

| Status | Conversions |
| --- | ---: |
| stable | 696 |
| supported | 575 |
| limited | 23 |
| experimental | 260 |
| deprecated | 0 |

## Conversions by source format

Targets marked `*` can run in the browser; the others run on the server. Experimental
conversions are offered with a warning and are not indexed.

## Tools

| Tool | Inputs | Output | Status | Routes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extract archive (`archive-extractor`) | zip, tar, tgz, gz, 7z, rar, tbz2, bz2, txz, xz, lzma, iso, cab, arj, lzh, cpio, rpm, deb, cbz, cbr | detect | stable | browser-archive (browser, stable); sevenzip (server, stable) |
| Base64 decoder (`base64-decode`) | base64, txt | detect | stable | browser-text (browser, stable) |
| Base64 encoder (`base64-encode`) | any file | base64 | stable | browser-text (browser, stable) |
| File inspector (`file-inspector`) | any file | json | stable | browser-text (browser, stable) |
| Image compressor (`image-compressor`) | jpg, webp | same | stable | browser-image (browser, stable) |
